name: showreel-c3-taj-mud

voice.text: How does the Taj stay white? Bleach, acid, or mud? Lock in your guess. Mud. Workers spread a clay paste over the yellowed marble. It dries, then washes off, taking the grime with it. Turns out, the Taj has had mud facials since 1994.

caption:
Bleach, acid or mud: what did you guess? 👇

To lift the yellow grime off the Taj Mahal's marble, workers coat it in a paste of fuller's earth clay (multani mitti). It dries, then it is washed off with water, taking the dirt with it. The Taj has had these mud packs since 1994.

Comment your letter before you watch it again, and send this to the friend who'd get it wrong.
